title: account-number — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins protocol::parse_account_number byte mapping for cross-implementation conformance: 20-character Crockford-base32 canonical form + Damm-32 check digit + display formatter (`MY-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-X`) + liberal-parsing normalization. Two case kinds: 'parse_ok' (canonical/display/lowercase/whitespace permutations all normalize to the same AccountNumber), 'parse_fail' (wrong length, non-Crockford characters per spec §5 step 7 strict, Damm-32 check failures including single-substitution + adjacent-transposition catches). Spec contract: docs/spec/protocol.md + docs/spec/account-number.md §3 + §5 + decisions.md 2026-04-28 Damm-32 polynomial form freeze.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'account-number/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: parse_ok — pin the liberal-parse normalization output

input_candidate_utf8_hex.description: Candidate input string as UTF-8 bytes (hex). May be canonical 20-char form, display form (`MY-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-X`), lowercase, missing/extra hyphens, with/without `MY-` prefix, with surrounding whitespace — all liberal-parse variants per spec §5.

expected_canonical_utf8_hex.description: 20-byte canonical form (19 entropy + 1 Damm-32 check) as uppercase Crockford-base32 ASCII bytes (hex). Implementations decode the input, run their parse equivalent, and assert AccountNumber.canonical bytes match.

expected_display_utf8_hex.description: 27-byte display form (`MY-` + four 4-char groups + dashes + final 4-char group with suffix + check) as ASCII bytes (hex). Implementations assert AccountNumber.display matches.

expected_hash_hex.description: 16-byte `SHA-256(canonical_ascii)[:16]` — the account_number_hash bound into both Argon2id salts (`protocol.md §3.1`) and stored at `vault.meta` offset 6 (`protocol.md §9.3`).

oneOf.title: parse_fail — pin the strict-reject failure surface

expected_kind.description: Rust reference returns Err(ProtocolError::AccountNumberInvalid) — a single non-distinguishing variant per spec §5 closed-error discipline. Ports MUST NOT distinguish which rule fired (length / Crockford-alphabet / Damm-32) beyond a single 'invalid account number' outcome at the user-visible surface.

informational_failure_reason.description: Human-readable note on which rule fired (e.g., 'wrong length: 19 chars after normalization', 'contains non-Crockford character O — spec §5 step 7 rejects strict, no I/L/O/U substitution', 'Damm-32 check fails: entropy char index 5 swapped'). Informational only — runner does not consume this field.
